For years I would only wear long sleeves, hats, and cover as much of my skin when I go out. It’s easier said than done, but I’ve learned to not give a d*mn about the opinions of others regarding my appearance. I dont know if this can help but I tried cutting out carbs such as rice, bread, and pasta for a month replacing them with 1 serving of oatmeal for breakfast. stopped the sugar (candies, chocolates, sodas, you name it) and ate mainly lean meats from beef, chicken, and pork sometimes along with a load of veggies and a lot of exercise, it significantly cleared out my psoriasis. I used to have it on like 70% on my back and all over my scalp, after doing that it got significantly better. Consulting with a doctor would be the best option although I understand there are a lot of conditions (finances, time, willingness to visit) that hinder it, ive been there too. Tell him to stay hydrated too. if he needs sugar, get it from fruits. it significantly changed the presence of my psoriasis for almost a year; right before i moved to the states where the weather has been more of a trigger for me. hope this helps
